verdict.rationale: GitLab's core is open source and self-hostable, and git data itself is an open, portable format; community evidence confirms users can fork or run their own instance without lock-in (gitlab-comm-3), and GitLab exposes a REST/GraphQL API for programmatic data access (gitlab-docs-10) alongside standard git protocol access (gitlab-docs-7). However, there is no explicit documentation cited for a comprehensive 'export all my data' feature covering issues, wikis, CI config, and settings in bulk open formats. Missing for 10: dedicated data-export/portability documentation, evidence of full-instance backup/export in open formats, and independent confirmation that a full account/data export actually works end-to-end.
